verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a voice-agent framework, so plugging MCP servers in as tool sources is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack, however, never documents the voice agent consuming MCP servers as tool sources. The only MCP mention is the CLI's context-hub, which registers itself as an MCP server for coding agents. That is a different role and does not show the voice agent loading MCP toolsets mid-call.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my voice agent can plug in MCP servers as tool sources so one integration grants it whole toolsets mid-call
